description: Frozen realistic deep-review corpus: 12 public repositories pinned to release-tag commits, 50 change-range slots assigned to real release-tag diffs, and deterministic whole-repo/range reports collected. No human labels exist and no quality gate is measured; this file is not a quality result.

review_policy.notes: Each subject is labelled independently by two humans before either sees Ozagia findings. A third human adjudicates disagreements. Synthetic fixtures remain separate regression checks and are never pooled into a realistic-corpus score.

repositories.reason: Small WSGI framework with tests, configuration and request-handling security surfaces; useful for change-range review and test-coverage checks. Pinned to release tag 3.1.3 (22d924701a6ae2e4cd01e9a15bbaf3946094af65); license and tree measured at that commit.

Widely used HTTP client in maintenance mode; exercises redirect, TLS configuration, timeout and resilience review. Pinned to release tag v2.34.2 (6e83187b8feb273ed4c6cdab5efd8d54901dfab3); license and tree measured at that commit.

Active sync/async HTTP client; exercises concurrency, connection-pool and failure-mode findings. Pinned to release tag 0.28.1 (26d48e0634e6ee9cdc0533996db289ce4b430177); license and tree measured at that commit.

Active test framework with deep architecture and plugin surfaces; held out from rule tuning to test generalisation. Pinned to release tag 9.2.0 (ae1d0ff57b8bd4252da9ade7353523ac0ac73281); license and tree measured at that commit.

Performance-sensitive Rust CLI; exercises resource bounds, traversal and output-path review. Pinned to release tag 16.0.0 (669cb4c755db20b26c3af3d923c042ae224c7496); license and tree measured at that commit.

Small Rust filesystem tool; exercises small-repository precision, error handling and filesystem failure modes. Pinned to release tag v10.5.2 (b2a287b3993768e0ec52f0852916917f23fb2a38); license and tree measured at that commit.

Go terminal tool with concurrency and I/O paths; exercises Go collectors and interactive failure modes. Pinned to release tag v0.75.0 (c7bf2b8eea25952dd257a466c0afa72faae206fb); license and tree measured at that commit.

Go web framework with middleware and routing security surfaces; held out from rule tuning. Pinned to release tag v1.12.0 (73726dc606796a025971fe451f0aa6f1b9b847f6); license and tree measured at that commit.

Maintenance-mode JavaScript framework; exercises routing, middleware and documentation/API review. Pinned to release tag v5.3.0 (cf6722bf89a86905281d9160b6482e08166b5ef0); license and tree measured at that commit.

TypeScript HTTP client; exercises typed public API, retries, timeouts and resilience review. Pinned to release tag v16.2.0 (6b5aafc1cd538998728be6f45c65b0f80bae01b2); license and tree measured at that commit.

C++ formatting library; exercises memory/lifetime, performance and header-only API review. Pinned to release tag 12.2.1 (208219daff58f2a7438f6931cc2ddc358acf33ef); license and tree measured at that commit.

Large C++ test framework; exercises architecture, test infrastructure and cross-language collector coverage. Pinned to release tag v1.18.0 (063de7e9578f82b369302001269680b4b1553359); license and tree measured at that commit.
